name: Apple pie
headline: Grandma's apple pie
raw_text:
Grandma's apple pie.
Ingredients: 6 apples, 200 g flour, 100 g butter, 80 g sugar, 1 egg, a pinch of cinnamon.
Peel and slice the apples. Rub the butter into the flour, add the egg, rest the dough for 30 minutes. Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.
